title: Daymark semantic comparison primary-source inventory
scope: General-purpose task/project core; synthetic examples only.

method.discovery: Preferred research discovery returned no qualifying sources; unrelated results were rejected. Explicit fallback used public web discovery to locate official documentation.
method.retrieval: Known URLs first used direct document extraction. Browser document extraction recovered JavaScript-rendered help after direct failure. Web-reader/index discovery was an intermediate fallback, not independent corroboration.
method.publication_boundary: Only primary URLs, original short summaries, source coordinates and retrieval metadata are retained here. Full text, private capture locations, internal service identifiers and credentials are excluded.
method.runtime_boundary: No installed-product, account, delivery, DST, concurrency or migration acceptance tests were performed.
method.copyright_boundary: No copyrighted full-text captures or source-code bodies are included. License texts were inspected privately and summarized by family.
method.source_snapshot_boundary: Branch source URLs are mutable. Extracted-text hashes record retrieved snapshots, not release pinning or raw-byte authenticity.

research_closure.basis: Bounded primary-source comparison complete; remaining gaps are explicit and do not block the stable semantic recommendations.
research_closure.implementation_acceptance: Not assessed. Proposed fixtures and decisions are not claims of engine completion or passed runtime tests.
research_closure.further_retrieval: No further exhaustive retrieval planned; revisit only for a material unresolved decision or a contradicted claim.

evidence_state_legend.usable_primary_content: Relevant primary text was retrieved and inspected at the stated coordinate; not a runtime feature test.
evidence_state_legend.usable_short_primary_artifact: A genuine short primary overview, index or structured artifact supports only its narrow stated summary.
evidence_state_legend.documented: Publisher describes a behavior or API contract; no independent implementation/runtime qualification implied.
evidence_state_legend.source_observed_bounded: Relevant source path was inspected; other paths, released versions and deployed configuration remain unqualified.
evidence_state_legend.unknown: Evidence did not establish the requested behavior; this is never a negative feature verdict.
evidence_state_legend.explicitly_unsupported: Use only when inspected primary text expressly excludes the behavior, within its version/platform bounds.
evidence_state_legend.proposal_or_inference: Analyst design recommendation or deduction, separately identified from vendor claims.
evidence_state_legend.retrieval_failed: Attempt yielded no usable evidence; not evidence of missing functionality.
evidence_state_legend.rejected_navigation_shell: A successful fetch returned navigation/index material instead of the requested detail; no detailed feature claim retained from it.
